This opt-in beta ships the `feat/libghostty-vt-adoption` branch, including the
updated libghostty-vt renderer, static renderer worker, terminal search and
selection, bounded static graphics, and renderer recovery improvements.

**Qualification status:** published with maintainer approval while native
macOS, real Homebrew installation, Lima VM/forwarding, and interactive
multi-window keyboard/graphics QA remain incomplete. The full upstream Ghostty
Debug test suite remains unverified after exhausting the development guest's
memory. This beta is not a fully qualified stable release. See the
[candidate QA report](https://github.com/brianrackle/codelima/blob/v0.3.0-beta.1/plans/homebrew_beta_qa.md)
and TODO #41, #43, and #44 for the remaining checks.

Local Go verification, race, daemon integration, and packaged renderer tests
passed. Release automation also requires those automated checks on each native
build target before publishing the archives.

Install the beta explicitly:

```sh
brew install brianrackle/codelima/codelima-beta
"$(brew --prefix codelima-beta)/bin/codelima" --version
"$(brew --prefix codelima-beta)/bin/codelima" daemon update
"$(brew --prefix codelima-beta)/bin/codelima" .
```

The beta formula is keg-only and leaves the existing `codelima` command
selected. Use the explicit beta path for beta commands. Stable users continue
following `codelima`; this prerelease does not become GitHub's Latest release.
Both channels share the default CodeLima home. Returning to an older stable
daemon may require stop/start if it cannot import the beta's handoff format.

Archives contain both `codelima` and `codelima-renderer-worker`; keep them
together for manual installations. Targets are macOS arm64, Linux amd64,
and Linux arm64.
